epics.title: Epic: Durations honoured by Microsoft Project
epics.body:
Project shows every written task as "1 day?" although duration is written at FixedData+42 (tenths of a minute), units at +46 and remaining duration at +52, and MPXJ reads them correctly. Something else marks the field as valid.

Hypotheses: a per-record flag in FixedMeta (47-byte item) or Fixed2Meta (92-byte item); the ACTUAL_DURATION_UNITS / DURATION_UNITS word; or a var-data duplicate.

Method: open a generated file in Project, type new durations, Save As, diff task records with scripts/analyze_mpp.py.
features: Diff Project-resaved file against generated file to locate duration validity flag
Write correct duration units word (incl. estimated flag 0x20) per task
Milestone flag for zero-duration tasks (FixedMeta bit)
Summary task duration computed in working time from children

epics.title: Epic: Resources and assignments
epics.body: TBkndRsc and TBkndAssn streams. The template contains phantom per-task assignment records that currently leak into output.
features: Clear or regenerate TBkndAssn so no phantom assignments appear
Write resource records (name, initials, type, max units) via 0x0C40 field class
Write assignment records linking tasks to resources with units
Resource GUIDs and cross-references in Fixed2Data

epics.title: Epic: Calendars
epics.body: TBkndCal streams. Project calendar (working week, hours), calendar exceptions, per-task calendar reference (CALENDAR_UNIQUE_ID).
features: Preserve template Standard calendar and set project default calendar
Write working-week definition (days/hours)
Write calendar exceptions (holidays)
Per-task calendar assignment

epics.title: Epic: Additional task fields
epics.body: Everything on a task beyond name/dates/duration/hierarchy.
features: Task notes (RTF var-data, field 15/94)
WBS and outline number strings
Constraints (type + date) and deadlines
Percent complete, actual start/finish
Priority, task type, effort-driven flags
Manual vs auto scheduled task mode (Fixed2Meta bit 1280)
Custom Text/Number/Date/Flag fields

epics.title: Epic: Project properties and metadata
features: Title in SummaryInformation stream (currently only Props TITLE)
Author, company, subject, keywords
Project finish date, status date, currency
Next-unique-ID counters so tasks added in Project after open get correct UIDs
Document Props14 header fields

epics.title: Epic: Round-trip fidelity and validation
epics.body: A file we write, opened and re-saved by Project, should describe the same schedule; and we should catch invalid output before Project does.
features: Golden-file test: generated vs Project-resaved schedule equality via MPXJ
Validator: uid uniqueness, parent references, level consistency, link cycles
Update view scroll position (CV_iew) so Gantt opens on the schedule, not 2006
Support templates written by Project 2013/2016/2019/2021/M365 (record-size detection)
Support DIFAT in CFB writer for files > 6.8 MB

epics.title: Epic: Packaging, docs and release
epics.body: Make it installable and usable by people who are not us.
features: Publish to PyPI
Sphinx/mkdocs site from docs/FORMAT_NOTES.md
Contribution guide for format findings (issue template exists)
Example gallery: JSON specs and screenshots of the result in Project

epics.title: Epic: NoodlePlanner integration
epics.body: Expose .mpp export from NoodlePlanner using this library.
features: Map NoodlePlanner markdown task model to pymppwriter Project/Task/Relation
Export endpoint serving .mpp with correct MIME type (application/vnd.ms-project)
Template management: bundle or upload template.mpp per deployment
Round-trip: import .mpp back into NoodlePlanner (via MPXJ or own reader)
